_note: A2 systems engineer: the single inventory behind REQUIREMENTS.md, VERIFICATION-MATRIX.md and claims.json (run build_requirements.py). Rows with 'text' are new requirement nodes written to team/A2/claims.json; rows without 'text' reuse A1's nodes in params/claims.json (title and text are read from there, never copied). method: A analysis, I inspection, T test, D demonstration. evidence: repo-relative files the owner writes; the matrix marks which exist. {P:dotted.key} in text/value/how is replaced by the params.json value at build time, so a number never goes stale here. 'retired_limits': the 39 ASM-A2-* limit nodes adopted into params.json#requirements.* (CHANGE-LOG D-14, CR-A2-01). They are no longer emitted; the build fails if a row still names one. A thin alias node is emitted only while another role's script still cites the old id (value copied from params.json, cites the parameter), and the build lists who.
revision: A2-R3 (A1-R5 action items, D-65 / D-66 / D-70 / D-71: R-LANDING-IMPACT 1.2 m/s at <= 10 deg any direction; R-SPIRAL added (t2 >= 3.3 s, roll-stabilised modes only); R-CG-RANGE on cg.x_range_m with B3's V1 ids and A5's assembly CG; R-VIBRATION re-run triggers; R-PROP-CLEAR, R-THERMAL, R-SERVO-TORQUE claim lists; R-LOADS keeps C1's 1.5 m/s bounds; R-TIPOVER / R-DISCONNECT r3 texts closed by A1, R-TIPOVER re-opened for D-64). A2-R2 was CR-A1-37: R3 texts; R-CG-RANGE reads cg.x_range_m; R-TIPOVER, R-LANDING-IMPACT per C5; R-VIBRATION tap-test + notch branch (D-45); R-DISCONNECT wire limits (CR-F1-01/15); R-FIELD-SETUP one spanner (D-40); R-AIRSPEED RSS; R-RC-LINK 25 mW + RSSI; R-JOINT-STACK per type (D-41); R-BUDGET / R-RESERVE / R-THERMAL evidence; CR-A1-17 closed)
_note_r3_text: A shared row (no 'text': the node lives in params/claims.json, A1) may carry 'r3_text': A2's wording for the next A1 edit of that node. REQUIREMENTS.md prints it under A1's current text and lists every pending one; CHANGE-REQUESTS.md carries it to A1. The build warns when A1's text already equals it (then delete the field). Evidence entries may end in a glob ('logs/T-X_*.csv'): the matrix counts a match as on disk.

requirements.how: Inspect the built aircraft against CONFIGURATION.md: 4 fixed motors on 2 fins, 2 elevon pairs, airspeed sensor, 4S, no field structural joint.
Energy budget: 2 min at hover power + 5 min at cruise power <= 0.8 x usable x pack energy (B1, E2); then one logged full mission landing with >= 20 % remaining (H2).

requirements.title: Props-off envelope
requirements.text: The props-off aircraft fits a {P:transport.envelope_props_off_m} m box envelope (span x depth x height incl. the tube ends, params.json#transport.envelope_props_off_m) in one piece with no structural field joint; span may grow only if the measured car box (R-CAR-FIT) allows
requirements.how: Fusion assembly bounding box from check.py (A5); tape measure on the built aircraft, props off, including the motor-tube ends.

Trimmed CLmax from XFOIL at Re 2-4e5 with the elevon up-trim, judged over the R3 CG range cg.x_range_m (D-44: at the target CG, CL-B3-VS-TRIM, and at the forward limit, CL-B2-STALL-GATE-FWD and CL-B3-VS-TRIM-FWD; the old 0.040 m case is void); slow-flight stall in FBWA at altitude with airspeed logged (H2).
B1 shows cruise speed >= 1.3 Vs at the gate mass (CL-A1-TRANSITION-GATE after D-01); airspeed logged at 'Transition FW done' (F4 message, H2 log).

requirements.r3_text: As-built take-off mass with pack <= {P:requirements.mtow_gate_kg} kg (H1 GT-06, guard-banded by CL-H1-WEIGH-ACCEPT); the allocations in params.json#mass.allocation_g (D-63) plus the {P:mass.growth_reserve_g} g A1 reserve equal the gate, and the reserve covers A3's growth by maturity plus the {P:requirements.build_overrun_kg} kg first-build overrun; every subsystem reports against its allocation
requirements.how: Roll-up of every parts.csv against mass_budget.json (A3); weigh the assembled aircraft with pack, 1 g scale (H1, T-A1-WEIGH).

requirements.title: Subsystem mass allocations
requirements.text: Each subsystem's flying mass (sum of mass_g over its parts.csv) <= its allocation in params/mass_budget.json; every part has a mass and a status word; the growth reserve ({P:mass.growth_reserve_g} g) is released only by A1 through a change request
requirements.how: A3 roll-up script per subsystem folder; weigh each subsystem's parts as built (H1 scale) and update parts.csv.

requirements.title: As-built CG range
requirements.text: As-built CG with the flight pack: x inside params.json#cg.x_range_m ({P:cg.x_range_m} m, D-62, D-120: forward limit = elevon trim <= the pure-pitch travel MIXING_GAIN leaves (0.65 of travel since CDR-14; was 0.5) at the trimmed CLmax (B3 V1 CL-B3-V-CG-FWD); first fixed-wing flights at x <= 0.0465 m, static margin >= 6.5 % (D-121), aft limit = static margin {P:requirements.static_margin_min} at 1.3 Vs with the CG {P:cg.z_target_m} m above the chord plane (CL-B3-V-CG-AFT-ENV); both on the CAD fins at {P:propulsion.stations.cant_deg} deg cant, rounded inward to 0.1 mm by A1), z inside cg.z_range_m ({P:cg.z_range_m} m; each 10 mm of height costs 1.85 mm of aft limit and 0.27 s of spiral t2), |y| <= {P:requirements.cg_lateral_max_m} m; the flight station of each weighed pack (546 / 550 / 590 g cases, D-64) comes from A3's live roll-up, from the {P:pod.pack_x_nominal_m} m datum with {P:pod.pack_aft_travel_m} m of aft travel in {P:pod.pack_spacer_step_m} m spacer steps; trim ballast counts inside the mass gate
requirements.source: params.json#cg.x_range_m, cg.z_range_m, cg.z_target_m, requirements.cg_lateral_max_m, requirements.elevon_trim_travel_max, requirements.static_margin_min, pod.pack_x_nominal_m, pod.pack_aft_travel_m, pod.pack_spacer_step_m
requirements.how: A3 CG roll-up from part positions with the pack at the {P:pod.pack_x_nominal_m} m datum (CL-A3-CG-X-RANGE, -X-STATIONS, -X-PRED, CL-A3-CG-Z-RANGE, CL-A3-CG-Y); A5's independent CAD roll-up of the same declared data (CL-A5-ASSY-CG-X against the aft limit, CL-A5-ASSY-CG-X-FWD against the forward limit, CL-A5-ASSY-CG-X-RANGE-USE); B3 places A3's CG against the V1 limits (CL-B3-V-CG-A3-FWD, -A3-AFT-ENV); A1's CL-A1-CG-RANGE-FWD/-AFT show the params range sits inside B3's limits and CL-A1-PACK-CG-FWD/-AFT the 546 / 590 g packs at their stations; H1 GT-07: two-scale CG jig (T-A3-CG-BALANCE = T-B3-CG-BALANCE = T-A5-CG-BALANCE), acceptance lines CL-H1-CG-ACCEPT-FWD/-AFT re-based on the D-62 range, with the pack at both ends of its travel.

requirements.title: Hover pitch-trim thrust split
requirements.text: In hover the upper/lower motor-pair thrust ratio needed to trim the CG z offset (and the motor-tube offset from the CG) <= {P:requirements.hover_split_max}, so trim uses at most (s-1)/2 = 12.5 % of the pitch differential and the rest stays for control (CHANGE-LOG D-18); from the A3 CG roll-up, then the mean upper vs lower motor outputs in the tethered-hover log
requirements.how: CL-A3-HOVER-SPLIT from CALC-A3-CG (z of the CG against the motor plane); H2: RCOU upper-pair mean / lower-pair mean over 30 s of tethered hover <= the limit.

AVL neutral point of the plank wing with the CAD fins and props, elevons neutral, with the CG {P:cg.z_target_m} m above the chord plane, judged at 1.3 Vs, the worst wing-borne speed (B3 V1: CL-B3-V-SM-A3-ENV, CL-B3-V-CG-A3-AFT-ENV; D-62; AVL 4 lattices against the hand formula within 0.4 %); FBWA pitch response on the twin, then the full aircraft (H2).

Thrust stand, one station, {P:propulsion.prop} on a fresh pack with the 100 A limiter duty found on the bench: full-throttle thrust >= 1.30 kgf per motor gives T/W 2.0 at 2.6 kg (H1, T-A1-THRUST-STATION); repeat on a 3.6 V/cell pack for the sag case.

Lean at 5 m/s from the flat-plate method <= requirements.hover_lean_max_deg (B1); twin then full aircraft hold position within 1 m in 5 m/s with logged lean (H2); fin-tip landing in 5 m/s without tip-over.

requirements.title: 8 m/s gust survive-and-land
requirements.text: The hover attitude needed to hold position in an 8 m/s gust (flat-plate method, wing broadside) is <= Q_A_ANGLE_MAX minus {P:requirements.gust_angle_margin_deg} deg (F4 sets Q_A_ANGLE_MAX accordingly), and the thrust needed at that lean (W / cos lean) leaves a thrust headroom >= {P:requirements.gust_thrust_headroom} at the gate mass with voltage sag
requirements.how: B1 recomputes the lean with the gate mass and fin area; F4 writes Q_A_ANGLE_MAX >= lean + 5 deg into the parameter file; T/W with sag from R-HOVER-TW divided by 1/cos(lean).

requirements.r3_text: Static tip-over angle toward the pod side (about the narrow axis of the four-foot stance, pad contact at z +/-0.218 m with the feet splayed, z_cg subtracted) >= {P:requirements.tipover_min_deg} deg at the worst flying CG (forward end of cg.x_range_m, top of cg.z_range_m, any accepted pack: 546 g listing to the CL-A1-PACK-ACCEPT line, D-64); landings are flown with a wingtip into the wind (flight card, C5 stance rules S1-S8), so the angle needed on that axis is the span-into-wind case, not the broadside one, and a 0.3 m/s drift landing at 10 deg of tilt does not tip (CL-C5-SIM3D-DRIFT-TIPS)
requirements.how: C5 planar geometry at the worst flying CG with the D5 pad pivot (CL-C5-TIPOVER-WORST 32.0 deg at D-62; A1's corner bound CL-A1-TIPOVER 30.98 deg at the forward limit and z 0.025; the needed angle for a span-into-wind landing CL-C5-TIPOVER-REQ-SPANWISE) and C5's 6-DOF drift landings (CL-C5-SIM3D-DRIFT-TIPS 0 of the 0.3 m/s, 10 deg cases tip); H1 GT-11: hinged board with an inclinometer about the narrow axis, pack at the forward limit (T-C5-TILT-BOARD); H3 prints the wingtip-into-wind rule on the flight card.

requirements.title: Directional stability in cruise
requirements.text: The plank wing with its two fins is directionally stable in cruise: Cn_beta >= +{P:requirements.cnbeta_min} /rad at 1.3 Vs with props included, elevons neutral and the CG at its aft limit (AVL, fins as vertical surfaces at +/-{P:fins.y_m} m with the LE on the tube at x {P:fins.le_x_m} m); the Dutch-roll mode is damped (no growing yaw oscillation in a hands-off FBWA run)
requirements.how: AVL stability derivatives at the aft CG (B3; J1's fin yaw-arm claim feeds it): CL-B3-V-CNB 0.0615 /rad on the CAD fins (0.0479 with the tube as the LE, CL-B3-V-CNB-TUBE), CL-B3-V-DR-ZETA 0.28; hands-off FBWA run with yaw rate logged (H2, T-B3-YAW-DOUBLET at the aft mark).

requirements.title: Spiral mode
requirements.text: In cruise at the gate mass the spiral mode's time to double t2 >= 3.3 s at every CG inside cg.x_range_m and cg.z_range_m ({P:cg.z_range_m} m; B3 sens_zcg.py gives 3.34 s at the top of the z range, 3.51 s at the {P:cg.z_target_m} m target, CL-B3-V-LAT-T2); the 4 s MIL-F-8785C Level 3 floor for a hand-flown aircraft is not required because wing-borne flight is flown only in roll-stabilised modes: every FLTMODE1-6 in K09L.param is a mode whose roll loop holds the bank (QSTABILIZE, QHOVER, QLOITER, QLAND, QRTL, FBWA, CRUISE, RTL, AUTO), never MANUAL, ACRO or STABILIZE (D-50), and no raw-stick fixed-wing mode is flown above 5 m AGL (flight card); the Dutch-roll and short-period dampings stay above B3's floors (R-DIRECTIONAL). A1's position D-66 option (b): the CG height stays, the limit is 3.3 s
requirements.value: >= 3.3 (A1 adopts requirements.spiral_t2_min_s, CR-A2-29); modes: roll-stabilised only
requirements.source: CHANGE-LOG D-66 (3.3 s typed until A1 adopts requirements.spiral_t2_min_s, CR-A2-29); params.json#cg.z_target_m, cg.z_range_m
requirements.how: B3: CL-B3-V-LAT-T2 (AVL lateral derivatives at the raised CG, Cl_beta +0.023; limit re-pointed at P:requirements.spiral_t2_min_s, verifies R-SPIRAL) plus sens_zcg.py at the top of cg.z_range_m; F4: a lint claim that no FLTMODE1-6 value is 0 (MANUAL), 2 (STABILIZE) or 4 (ACRO) in K09L.param (fsw_check.py; today 17 / 18 / 19 / 5 / 7 / 11); H3: the rule on the flight card; H2: a hands-off FBWA bank hold of >= 10 s in the first fixed-wing log shows no bank divergence.

requirements.title: Hover control authority
requirements.text: At the gate mass in hover, motor-differential control gives an angular acceleration on each body axis >= {P:requirements.hover_ctrl_accel_min} rad/s2 and >= {P:requirements.hover_ctrl_factor} x the acceleration the 5 m/s wind moment demands, using <= 30 % of hover thrust per motor as differential after the pitch-trim split (R-HOVER-SPLIT); the 30 % cap applies on every axis, yaw included (CR-B3-16: D-27 raised the cant to 7 deg rather than lift the cap); yaw (about the hover vertical, from the {P:propulsion.stations.cant_deg} deg tangential cant plus prop reaction torque) is the axis to show
requirements.how: Moment arms (fins.y_m, fins.half_height_m) x thrust slope from the thrust table over the inertia from A3 (B3); twin holds position within 1 m in 5 m/s and the log shows no motor output saturation (H2).

requirements.title: Elevon authority in cruise
requirements.text: At 1.3 Vs with the CG at its aft limit, the elevons trim level flight using <= {P:requirements.elevon_trim_travel_max} of the +/-{P:wing.elevon.deflection_deg} deg travel, and the remaining travel gives a steady roll rate >= {P:requirements.roll_rate_min_degs} deg/s (AVL with roll damping); pitch recovers a 10 deg upset without stalling
requirements.how: AVL trim and control derivatives at the aft CG (B3); FBWA flight with logged roll rate at full stick (H2).
Measure the cut panels (D1); B3 confirms the fraction gives R-CRUISE-AUTHORITY; frozen on the twin's result (H2).

requirements.title: Elevon servo torque
requirements.text: Each elevon servo's rated stall torque at the 6 V UBEC rail (mec.servo.stall_torque_6v_kgfcm) >= {P:requirements.servo_torque_factor} x the summed hinge moment of its panels at {P:wing.elevon.deflection_deg} deg deflection at the design dive speed VD = {P:requirements.vd_ms} m/s, hinge moment from XFOIL carried to the servo output through D6's linkage ratio (B2 R3, CL-B2R3-SERVO-TORQUE-REQ); the linkage holds that load without the horn or clevis slipping
requirements.value: >= {P:requirements.servo_torque_factor} x hinge moment at VD, at the servo output, 6 V
requirements.how: B2 hinge-moment coefficient x q x S_e x c_e x {P:requirements.servo_torque_factor} x D6's four-bar torque factor (CL-D6-TORQUE-FACTOR): CL-B2R3-SERVO-TORQUE-REQ 3.49 kgf cm against the rated 3.9 at 6 V (+11 %; at 4.8 V it would fail by 13 %, so the 6 V rail is part of the requirement, D-71); the older CL-B2-SERVO-TORQUE-REQ 3.93 at the hinge is information; D6 picks the servo; bench: hold the surface at full deflection against a spring scale at the computed load with the servo on 6 V (H1, T-B2-HINGE).

requirements.r3_text: Geometric gap between the blade swept volume (E1's blade envelope, +10 / -6 mm about the disc, on the {P:propulsion.stations.cant_deg} deg canted axis) and any structure or another prop's swept volume >= {P:requirements.prop_clearance_min_m} m at every station: to the CF motor tube (the governing gap since the cant sense was corrected, D-52 / D-61), to the wing upper skin, to the collar front and to the other prop; shown by three independent codes (E1 probe, B4 exact geometry, A5 check.py hull) and by a printed 25 mm gauge on the built aircraft
requirements.how: CL-E1-TIP-GAP-TUBE (blade swept volume to the tube, 26.1 mm at the D-61 face_ahead 7.5 mm; was 21.1 FAIL at 2.5 mm), CL-B4-GAP-TUBE-ENV (the same gap from B4's independent code; stored 21.1 mm at the R4 mount until B4 re-runs on D-61, where CL-B4-GAP-TUBE-FIX5 gives 26.1), CL-B4-TIP-WING (blade to the wing upper skin, 34.2 mm; 35.8 at the R5 mount, CL-B4-TIP-WING-FIX5), A5's check.py keep-out hull test (CL-A5-* keep-out claims, 0 errors expected after D3's R5 mount), A1's uncanted frame bound CL-A1-PROP-CLEAR as information; built aircraft: printed 25 mm gauge between the blade trailing face at the tip and the tube with the blade turned through the wing-side position, and between the tip and the wing skin at y 0.32 (T-B4-INSTALLED, T-E1-MOTOR-RM, before the first hover per README); D3's SPEC lists the gap at each station.

requirements.title: Airspeed sensor placement and accuracy
requirements.text: The pitot sits outside the prop slipstream in cruise (>= {P:requirements.pitot_wash_clearance_radii} prop radius laterally clear of every disc edge, or ahead of the prop plane; B4's wash-error bound CL-B4-PITOT <= 2 % is the working form), and the airspeed error at cruise ({P:performance.cruise_ms} m/s), taken as the root-sum-square of the error budget (sensor, prop wash, calibration residual, resolution) after ARSPD_AUTOCAL and reciprocal legs, is <= {P:requirements.airspeed_err_max_ms} m/s (D-37: the margin from cruise down to 1.3 Vs is 0.49-0.58 m/s); in flight, the mean of |ARSPD - GPS-derived true airspeed| over a four-leg reciprocal box in calm air is within that limit
requirements.how: B4 marks the wash boundary (1.66 % worst at the transition, 0.31 % cruise); F3's RSS budget CL-F3-ASPD-ERR 0.44 m/s (linear sum 0.77 is information); H2 flies T-F3-ARSPD-CAL: ARSPD_AUTOCAL, then a four-leg reciprocal box at 16 m/s in calm air, ARSPD vs GPS ground speed averaged over opposite legs.

requirements.title: Motor and ESC current with the pack-current limiter
requirements.text: (a) Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX <= {P:performance.full_throttle_current_a} A is set in the flight-software parameter file and verified on the bench (four motors, props on, restrained frame, fresh pack, 2 s full throttle: BAT.Curr <= {P:performance.full_throttle_current_a} A); (b) per-motor battery current with the limiter <= {P:propulsion.motor_max_a} A (motor rating, 30 s, propulsion.motor_max_a); (c) unlimited single-motor burst at 16.8 V <= {P:propulsion.esc_burst_a} A (ESC 10 s rating, propulsion.esc_burst_a; the {P:propulsion.esc_cont_a} A continuous rating is never reached in a limited flight) and no full-throttle run longer than {P:env.full_throttle_max_s} s from a hover-warm motor (D-42); (d) hover pack current within +/-{P:requirements.hover_current_tol} x {P:performance.hover_current_a} A of that value on the thrust stand and in the tethered hover. Unlimited full throttle at 14.8 V is not a requirement: the limiter is the design case (CR-E1-07)
requirements.value: limiter <= {P:performance.full_throttle_current_a}; per motor <= {P:propulsion.motor_max_a}; burst <= {P:propulsion.esc_burst_a} at 16.8 V; full throttle <= {P:env.full_throttle_max_s} s; hover {P:performance.hover_current_a} +/- {P:requirements.hover_current_tol}
requirements.source: params.json#performance.full_throttle_current_a, performance.hover_current_a, requirements.hover_current_tol, propulsion.motor_max_a, propulsion.esc_burst_a, propulsion.esc_cont_a, env.full_throttle_max_s
requirements.how: F4: Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX = 100 in K09L.param (inspection, parameter diff); E1: CL-E1-ILIM-I 24.8 A per motor with the limiter, CL-E1-IMAX-168-55 51.6 A unlimited burst; H1 GT-13: restrained-frame full-throttle run with dataflash BAT.Curr and a clamp meter on one ESC lead (<= 100 A pack, <= 25 A per motor); GT-02 single-station stand, fresh pack, unlimited 2 s burst <= 55 A; tethered hover BATT current 27 A +/- 15 %.

requirements.title: Flight pack mass and capacity
requirements.text: Each flight pack weighs <= {P:battery.mass_kg} kg as received (else A3 re-budgets power before any CAD freezes) and delivers >= {P:requirements.pack_capacity_min_frac} x nameplate capacity ({P:battery.capacity_ah} Ah) at 1C down to 3.5 V/cell on the charger's discharge test
requirements.how: H1 GT-05 on arrival: weigh each pack (1 g scale), one 1C discharge per pack on the charger to 3.5 V/cell with Ah and the voltage curve, IR at 25 and 10 degC (T-E2-WEIGH, T-E2-CAPACITY, T-E2-IR); one row per pack in team/E2/pack_log.csv (CR-H1-07); acceptance lines CL-H1-PACK-CAP-MIN, CL-H1-PACK-IR10-MAX.

requirements.value: within rating over {P:env.ambient_design_c}; ceiling {P:env.ambient_ceiling_c} reported; pack at take-off <= {P:env.pack_takeoff_max_c}; full throttle <= {P:env.full_throttle_max_s} s
requirements.how: E3 transient heat balance for the motor, the ESC on its fin pad in the wash, the pack in the pod and the FC over the design mission at 30 degC, at the gate mass (CL-E3-MOTOR-PEAK, CL-E3-ESC-PEAK, CL-E3-PACK-END, CL-E3-FC-PEAK against thermal.*_temp_max_c) and at A3's predicted as-designed mass with design inputs (CL-E3-ASD-MOTOR-PEAK, -ASD-ESC-PEAK, -ASD-PACK-END, -ASD-FC-PEAK; CL-E3-CEIL-ASD), CL-E3-SWEEP-DES over the ambient range, CL-E3-CEIL-MISSION as the flight-card ceiling, CL-E3-GT04-ESC-RISE as the GT-04 pass line (ESC <= 33 K, motor <= 38 K at the end of the sequence); the SU2 ESC-pad film coefficient behind the ESC peak (CL-E3-CFD-H-HOV, -FEQ, D-67) is validated by T-E3-ESC-PAD-CFD on the half-fin mock-up before the GT-04 pass line is frozen; tests T-E3-MOTOR-TAU and T-E3-ESC-PAD on the stand (H1 GT-04, thermocouple and IR), T-E3-MISSION after the first full missions (H2); H3 prints the ceiling, the 20-34 degC pack take-off window and the 10 s full-throttle rule on the flight card.

requirements.title: Load cases defined
requirements.text: C1 publishes numbered load cases for every structure before sizing: flight limit load factor +{P:requirements.load_factor_limit_pos} / {P:requirements.load_factor_limit_neg} at the gate mass with ultimate = {P:requirements.safety_factor_ult} x limit, VD = {P:requirements.vd_ms} m/s; hover at the thrust limit ({P:requirements.thrust_limit_per_motor_n} N per motor) at the motor stations; transition (thrust limit plus 1.3 Vs aero load); fin-tip landing: C1's L1 (level on four feet, 1.5 m/s, 2/3 W lift) and L4 / L5 (one foot first, mu 0.7) at 1.5 m/s stay the structural bounds (D-65) above the {P:requirements.landing_sink_ms} m/s at {P:requirements.landing_attitude_err_deg} deg requirement case, n <= {P:requirements.landing_n_design}, with C5's simulated foot side load (CL-C5-SIM3D-SIDE-LOAD limit / -SIDE-ULT ultimate) as the design side load; tip-over onto a wingtip; transport ({P:requirements.box_drop_m} m box drop); handling (one-hand carry at the pod)
requirements.source: params.json#requirements.load_factor_limit_pos, requirements.load_factor_limit_neg, requirements.safety_factor_ult, requirements.vd_ms, requirements.thrust_limit_per_motor_n, requirements.landing_sink_ms, requirements.landing_attitude_err_deg, requirements.landing_n_design, requirements.box_drop_m
requirements.how: LOADS.md lists each case with the load, where it acts and the script that computed it; every structural claim cites a case id.

requirements.title: Structural margins
requirements.text: Every primary load path (spar, spar-slot bond, motor tube, through-core block, fin-tube joint, fin root bond, motor mount, pod-to-wing bond, pack retention, feet) has a margin of safety >= 0 at ultimate load ({P:requirements.safety_factor_ult} x limit) against stated material allowables, and the spar tip deflection at limit load <= {P:requirements.spar_deflection_max} x the semi-span
requirements.value: MS >= 0 at {P:requirements.safety_factor_ult} x limit; deflection <= {P:requirements.spar_deflection_max} x b/2
requirements.how: Beam and joint calculations per load case (C2-C6, each emitting claims); proof load of the spar and one motor station to limit load on the bench with deflection measured (H1).

requirements.title: Fin-tube-block joint
requirements.text: The fin, motor tube and printed through-core block transfer the motor-station loads ({P:requirements.thrust_limit_per_motor_n} N per motor at the thrust limit, plus the landing case and the tip-over case G2) into the spar across the tube-to-spar offset (tube at x {P:fins.tube.x_m} m) with margin >= 0 at ultimate, using printed parts and epoxy on a real 22 mm tube; a printed clip is fit-checked on the tube before the December order
requirements.how: C4 load path and bond-area calculation; D3 prints the block and clip; photo of the clip on the tube in the fins SPEC before the order.

requirements.title: Rotor-excited vibration
requirements.text: (a) Fin stations: the first bending and torsion natural frequencies of each motor tube + through-core block + half-fins + mount assembly with motors fitted lie outside +/-{P:requirements.vibration_sep_frac} of 1P at hover rpm and of 2P (blade pass) at hover and cruise rpm; the operating points are the criterion of record and B4's 80-330 Hz whole-band rule is advisory (CR-C4-06); C4's CL-C4-D3-SEP on the two-layer fin (D-26) supersedes CL-J1-TUBE-MODE-SEP, and the 3-D solid FE of the as-designed station (CL-C4-SIM-SEP 0.29: lower station 255.5 Hz against 2P cruise 198.2 Hz at 5 946 rpm with the 84.2 g motor) is the value of record; re-run triggers (D-70, CR-C4-39): C4 re-runs the station model when the cruise rpm (CL-B4-CRUISE-RPM) exceeds 6 390 rpm or a station's mass grows more than 15 % above the as-designed 84.2 g motor + 7.6 g ESC + 4 g bullets. (b) Wing modes: the station-participating wing modes (antisymmetric torsion 12-15 Hz, in-plane ~215 Hz) cannot clear the same windows with any spar from 16 to 25 mm (CL-C2-WING-MODE-SEP, D-45), so they are closed by the tap-test branch: the tap test of the finished wing with motors fitted (T-C2-TAP-TEST) shows each such mode either damped or inside the rpm-tracking harmonic notch (F4 INS_HNTCH_* on ESC rpm, CL-F4-NOTCH-LOW, covering 1P and 2P over the rpm range), the rate-loop crossover stays <= 5 Hz, and B3 carries the 12-15 Hz antisymmetric torsion mode in the hover loop model. (c) The flight-controller vibration (ArduPilot VIBE) stays < {P:requirements.fc_vibe_max_ms2} m/s2 in hover with Clip = 0
requirements.value: fin-station separation >= {P:requirements.vibration_sep_frac} at the operating points; wing modes: tap test + notch; VIBE < {P:requirements.fc_vibe_max_ms2}
requirements.how: (a) C4 beam + shell model of the station with D3's geometry (CL-C4-D3-SEP 0.35 shell) and the 3-D solid FE of the as-designed station (CL-C4-SIM-SEP 0.29; re-run above 6 390 rpm cruise or +15 % station mass), then H1 taps each motor bell of the finished wing in y and z with the FC IMU logging and reads the FFT against 1P/2P (T-C4-TAP-D3); (b) C2's spar + skin model (CL-C2-F-TORSION-ANTI/-SYM, information), H1 tap test of the whole wing (T-C2-TAP-TEST) with F4's notch set from the measured modes; C2 then emits a claim that every station-participating mode is damped or notched (CR-A2-22); (c) VIBE and Clip in the first hover log (H2).

requirements.title: Pack retained in a crash
requirements.text: The pack stays in the pod and the hatch stays closed under a {P:requirements.crash_decel_g} g deceleration in any axis (5 m/s arrested in 0.10 m of foam crush); the strap, tray, stops and pod-to-wing bond carry that load with margin >= 0, and the XPS crush block ahead of the pack (D-25) holds any 503-680 g pack to <= 100 g in a 5 m/s nose-in crash
requirements.how: C3 sizes strap and tray for 12 x pack weight (65 N at 0.55 kg); bench pull on the strapped pack with a spring scale to 65 N in each axis (H1).

requirements.title: Fin-tip landing
requirements.text: The four replaceable constant-force feet absorb a hard landing at {P:requirements.landing_sink_ms} m/s sink (the pilot's down-stick limit Q_PILOT_SPD_DN, which F4 holds <= this value; the controller's own final descent is Q_LAND_FINAL_SPD 0.3 m/s) with 2/3 W of lift still on, at any touchdown tilt <= {P:requirements.landing_attitude_err_deg} deg of combined tilt in any direction (pitch, roll or diagonal: one foot takes the energy first, D-65), with airframe load factor <= {P:requirements.landing_n_design} at the as-designed mass and >= 3 mm of the usable stroke left on the worst foot (foot stroke >= {P:requirements.foot_crush_stroke_min_m} m, C5's 3 mm guard), no damage beyond the feet; the foot side load from the pads scrubbing at mu 0.7 while the aircraft rotates onto the other feet (CL-C5-SIM3D-SIDE-LOAD limit, -SIDE-ULT ultimate) is the design side load for the shoe sleeve, the fin tip and the fin root (D5, C4 / D3, C1); shown by C5's 6-DOF touchdown model with four crushing feet (CR-C5-17) validated by T-C5-AIRCRAFT-DROP, while C1's 1.5 m/s level and one-foot cases L1 / L4 stay the structural bounds (R-LOADS); a foot is replaced in <= {P:requirements.foot_replace_max_min} min in the field (snap-fit piston, no adhesive); horizontal groundspeed at contact <= — m/s (C5 derives it from the 30 deg tip-over margin and the foot friction; NASA CR-132423 p. 60 tolerates 2 kt = 1.03 m/s in hover just before touchdown; review/NASA-CR-132423-COMPLIANCE.md C-14, G-05), logged at every touchdown by H2 (M2)
requirements.value: sink {P:requirements.landing_sink_ms} at tilt <= {P:requirements.landing_attitude_err_deg} in any direction, 2/3 W lift; n <= {P:requirements.landing_n_design}; stroke left >= 3 mm of {P:requirements.foot_crush_stroke_min_m}; replace <= {P:requirements.foot_replace_max_min}
requirements.source: params.json#requirements.landing_sink_ms, requirements.landing_attitude_err_deg, requirements.landing_n_design, requirements.foot_crush_stroke_min_m, requirements.foot_replace_max_min, cg.foot_height_m
requirements.how: C5 6-DOF model (claims.sim.json): CL-C5-SIM3D-V-SINK-10 (sink that still clears 10 deg in any direction >= landing_sink_ms), CL-C5-SIM3D-STROKE (worst foot stroke <= D5's usable 35 mm), CL-C5-SIM3D-BOTTOM-TILT (tilt that bottoms the stroke >= 10 deg), CL-C5-SIM3D-N (n at the as-designed mass <= landing_n_design), CL-C5-SIM3D-SIDE-LOAD / -SIDE-ULT (design side load), CL-C5-FEA-SHOE-SF (shoe sleeve RF >= 1 at the ultimate side load on D5's D-65 sleeve); the planar claims CL-C5-DROP-PAIR-PITCH / -ROLL, CL-C5-DYN-LEVEL-FREE-PROP, CL-C5-DYN-N-LEVEL stay as the level and single-axis cases; C1's CL-C1-N-LAND-STROKE-MIN, CL-C1-WINGTIP-STRIKE-ANGLE, CL-C1-FOOT-D5-RATIO; F4's Q_PILOT_SPD_DN 1.2 in K09L.param (CL-F4-DESCENT); H1 GT-10: single-foot rig (T-C5-FOOT-RIG), then drop the ballasted airframe level from 0.115 m (1.5 m/s, C1's L1 bound) and at 10 deg pitch, roll and diagonal from 0.073 m (1.2 m/s) onto the mat (T-C5-AIRCRAFT-DROP = T-C1-FOOT-DROP), FC IMU >= 1 kHz, strokes within 3 mm of the model, inspect fins, tubes and shoe sleeves; time a foot swap.

requirements.value: rating >= {P:requirements.disconnect_factor} x I_cont; momentary {P:electrical.peak_current_a}; rise <= {P:electrical.wire_temp_rise_max_c} steady / {P:electrical.wire_temp_rise_short_max_c} (< 60 s) / {P:electrical.pack_lead_rise_max_c} pack leads
requirements.source: params.json#requirements.disconnect_factor, electrical.wire_temp_rise_max_c, electrical.wire_temp_rise_short_max_c, electrical.pack_lead_rise_max_c, electrical.peak_current_a, performance.hover_current_a, performance.full_throttle_current_a
requirements.how: F1: CL-F1-DISC-REQ-CONT 37.8 A and -SHORT 53.7 A against the AS150U ratings (CL-F1-AS150U-CONT/-SHORT/-BURST; F1 opens the maker sheet before the order), wire rises CL-F1-MAIN-RISE/-PEAK, CL-F1-ESC-RISE/-PEAK, CL-F1-PACKLEAD-RISE/-PEAK against the three limits; H1 GT-04: thermocouple on the main lead, one ESC lead and a pack lead at the continuous current for 2 min and through a 120 A punch (T-F1-WIRE-HEAT), AS150U heat run (T-F1-CONN-HEAT).

requirements.title: Avionics power
requirements.text: The UBEC/BEC continuous rating >= {P:requirements.ubec_factor} x the summed avionics current plus both servos at stall; the flight-controller rail stays >= 4.8 V with both servos stalled on the bench; the current and voltage sensor reads within +/-5 % of a meter at hover current
requirements.how: Current budget from the datasheets (F1); bench stall both servos while watching the rail voltage; compare BATT_CURRENT with a clamp meter on the thrust stand (H1).

requirements.title: Wiring is an installation
requirements.text: Every wire in the wire list has a route, supports <= {P:requirements.wire_support_max_m} m apart, chafe protection at every edge, strain relief at every connector and a service loop across each elevon hinge; the ESC-to-motor leads run along the fin; no connector carries structural load; the pack plug is the only field disconnect
requirements.how: Walk the built harness against the wire list with a ruler; every row ticked (F2); A4 checks every wire edge is acknowledged.
Board name on firmware.ardupilot.org under Plane stable (dated screenshot in the SPEC) before the order; a bench log written to SD/flash and downloaded.

requirements.title: Tailsitter parameter file
requirements.text: The parameter file in subsystems/flight-software/ sets Q_ENABLE 1, Q_TAILSIT_ENABLE 1, Q_TAILSIT_MOTMX for all four motors, Q_FRAME_CLASS 1, Q_FRAME_TYPE 1, Q_OPTIONS bit 18 (arm only in VTOL), Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX {P:performance.full_throttle_current_a} (R-ESC-CURRENT); the output map matches stations UR/UL/LR/LL and their rotation directions; every parameter name is checked against the installed firmware version named in the file header
requirements.how: F4 fsw_check.py: lint, mirror and name check of K09L.param (63 of 113 names matched to source on 2026-11-09; the other 50 are checked when SITL S1 loads the file, T-F4-SITL-NAMES; 3 LEGACY cm/s duplicates stay until the stable tag is fixed, CR-F4-09); CL-F4-MOTOR-MAP-ERR 0; H1 GT-12: motor test in the ground station, props off, each station spins in the right direction in order (T-F4-BENCH-MAP).

requirements.title: Arming and emergency stop
requirements.text: Arming requires a hardware or RC arm switch and the full ARMING_CHECK set; an RC emergency-stop switch stops all four motors within {P:requirements.estop_time_max_s} s from any mode; props are off for every bench test of the electrics
requirements.how: Bench with props off: arm refused with a failed check, then time the stop from switch to zero rpm in the log (H1).

requirements.title: Failsafes and geofence
requirements.text: RC loss -> QLAND or QRTL; GCS loss (if telemetry is used) -> as configured; battery low -> return, critical -> land; Q_TRANS_FAIL -> QRTL; geofence = the RFS sub-field polygon plus the {P:mission.ceiling_ft_agl} ft ceiling with a fence action; each action is demonstrated in SITL and on the bench (props off, transmitter switched off, voltage simulated) before the first flight
requirements.how: SITL run per failsafe with the log attached (F4); bench demonstration of RC loss and low battery with the resulting mode shown in the ground station (H1); fence polygon loaded and checked on the map.

requirements.title: RC link and telemetry
requirements.text: The ELRS ground range check at 25 mW (the RadioMaster Pocket's lowest setting; 10 mW is not offered) passes at {P:requirements.range_check_min_m} m with LQ >= {P:requirements.rc_lq_min}, no failsafe, and the better of 1RSS/2RSS >= {P:requirements.rc_rssi_check_min_dbm} dBm in every position (the RSSI line that proves >= 10 dB of fade margin at the {P:requirements.vlos_max_m} m VLOS limit at 100 mW); in flight, link quality stays >= {P:requirements.rc_lq_min} and RSSI >= -102 dBm in the logs out to the geofence radius (CL-F4-FENCE-RADIUS, half the VLOS limit), and the {P:requirements.vlos_max_m} m case at {P:mission.ceiling_ft_agl} ft is covered by analysis (CL-F5-LINK-MARGIN); RSSI/LQ and telemetry are logged
requirements.value: range check {P:requirements.range_check_min_m} at 25 mW: LQ >= {P:requirements.rc_lq_min}, RSSI >= {P:requirements.rc_rssi_check_min_dbm}; flight LQ >= {P:requirements.rc_lq_min}
requirements.how: F5 link budget (CL-F5-LINK-MARGIN 21.6 dB at 515 m, CL-F5-RC-RSSI-REQ -93.8 dBm pass line, CL-F5-RC-RSSI-PRED -82.2 dBm); H1 GT-14 / T-F5-RANGE: aircraft 1 m up on a stand, motors at 20 % props off, 100 m, four headings x two attitudes, LQ and RSSI read from the transmitter; daily short check before the first flight; H2: RSSI/RXLQ messages in every flight log, worst value at the farthest point (T-F5-FLIGHT-LINK).

requirements.title: Compass and GPS
requirements.text: Compass interference from the motor and pack currents, expressed as the field they add at the compass divided by the total Earth field (the compassmot convention, CR-F3-09), <= {P:requirements.compass_interference_max} at hover current (the 100 A limiter case is information); the GPS/compass mast keeps >= {P:requirements.gps_mast_clearance_m} m from the main power leads, PDB and UBEC; HDOP <= {P:requirements.hdop_max} before arming
requirements.how: F3 loop-area model (CL-F3-COMPASS-RATIO 0.075 at hover, CL-F3-GPS-CLEAR 0.154 m); H1 GT-13: compassmot on the restrained frame or tethered, interference percentage read from the ground station (T-F3-COMPASSMOT); ruler from the mast to the nearest power item; HDOP in the pre-arm log.

Box fit: CL-A1-BOX-FIT (props-off envelope transport.envelope_props_off_m + 2 x box_wall_m against the 0.54 m box; slack 17 mm along the chord today); drop: D7's CL-D7-A1-BOX-DROP-ALLOW >= box_drop_m with >= 70 mm cradle stroke (the fallback 0.50 m box carries a 'max drop 0.15 m' label, D-31); D7 measures two cars before the freeze (R-CAR-FIT); place the props-off aircraft on its cradles, close the lid, weigh the loaded box without packs (D7).

requirements.title: Field set-up time
requirements.text: From the closed box to the arm check in <= {P:requirements.field_setup_max_min} min by one person with no tool other than the one 10 mm prop spanner kept in the box pouch (D-40: the M6 prop nuts at 1.5 N m, left-hand thread on the CW motors, are the only field joint that needs a tool): transmitter on, fit four props, plug in the pitot boom, pack in from the LiPo bag and strap, close the AS150U, arm check; the sequence is the checklist in the box (transport.field_steps)
requirements.how: D7's step budget CL-D7-SETUP-MIN (265 s); timed by a second person on three field days with the checklist; any step needing a second tool fails the requirement.

requirements.title: Box fits two cars
requirements.text: The loaded box ({P:requirements.box_external_m} m external; fallback 0.50 m high with a 'max drop 0.15 m' label, D-31) fits in at least two team members' cars (back seat or hatch), measured with the box dimensions and recorded in subsystems/transport/CAR-FIT.md before the box height and P6/P9 are frozen
requirements.how: Tape measure of the opening and the cargo space of two cars against the box_external_m dimensions; table in the transport SPEC.

requirements.title: Build processes
requirements.text: Every part in every parts.csv is bought or made by one of: hot-wire XPS from printed templates, packing-tape skin, knife- or laser-cut foam board, FDM PETG or PLA, epoxy or CA bonds, standard fasteners, hand-cut CF tube; no composite lay-up, no machining beyond drilling; printed parts <= {P:requirements.print_max_m} m on any axis
requirements.how: G1 checks the process column of every parts.csv against the list; G3 confirms the printer bed; the Jacobs foam-board laser answer is recorded (knife is the fallback).
Sum of G4's work-package estimates (plan 70-85 h); hours logged per build session against the plan.

requirements.title: Milestones
requirements.text: Twin flown before the order; electronics and CF tubes ordered by about 2026-11-20, everything else by 2026-12-15; first XPS hover by build week 4; first transition by week 7; complete by 2027-04-30 with one crash-repair loop (>= 1.5 weeks calendar) and the 7-business-day RFS request lead inside the plan
requirements.value: order 2026-12-15; hover wk 4; transition wk 7; done 2027-04-30
requirements.how: Dated schedule with the critical path and one repair loop; each milestone ticked with the date it happened.

requirements.title: Crash repair
requirements.text: A crashed wing core is re-cut and skinned in <= {P:requirements.core_recut_max_days} day from stock on hand (>= 1 spare XPS sheet, hot-wire templates and printed-part STLs kept in the repo); the BOM holds spares: 1 motor, 4 ESCs, 8 props, 1 CF tube, 4 feet
requirements.how: Spare lines present in the BOM (I1); the second core cut during the build is timed from sheet to skinned core (G2).

I1's priced BOM with tax, shipping, spares and the ground-test line (D-39): CL-I1-SPEND-BASE and CL-I1-SPEND-PESS <= budget_usd (CR-I1-12); re-priced on order day (build_bom.py), A1's CL-A1-RESERVE is the cross-check.

Reserve = budget_usd - spend from the BOM on order day: CL-I1-RESERVE-PESS >= crash_cost_usd (gate 1 of the tie-break) and CL-I1-RESERVE-BASE >= crash_reserve_planned_usd (CR-I1-12); the lever order for a new line is D-39.

requirements.title: Every part connected
requirements.text: Every part in every interfaces.json has at least one structural interface and, where it carries current or heat, an electrical or thermal one; interfaces/merge_check.py and fusion/check.py pass with zero floating parts and zero unacknowledged edges
requirements.how: Run both checkers; the merged report lists zero floating parts (A4) and the Fusion stub build shows every component on a joint (A5).

requirements.title: Joint stacks
requirements.text: Every fastened or bonded joint in the README joint table has a joint-stack entry (team/C6/joint_stacks.json, M3 only): fastener size x length and grade or adhesive, hole or insert, thread engagement by type >= {P:requirements.thread_engagement_min} x nominal diameter into metal, >= {P:requirements.thread_engagement_insert_min} x into a heat-set insert, >= {P:requirements.thread_engagement_plastic_min} x self-tapping into printed plastic, a nyloc fully on with >= {P:requirements.nyloc_pitches_min} pitches showing (D-41), torque or 'snug + threadlocker', tool, access direction, install and removal order
requirements.value: engagement >= {P:requirements.thread_engagement_min} d metal / {P:requirements.thread_engagement_insert_min} d insert / {P:requirements.thread_engagement_plastic_min} d plastic; nyloc + {P:requirements.nyloc_pitches_min} pitches
requirements.how: C6 one row per joint id with the engagement claims (CL-C6-PINCH-ENGAGE-RF, CL-C6-FC-ENGAGE-RF, D3's CL-D3-SCREW-ENGAGE) citing the per-type key; A4's merge_check.py confirms every fastened edge in interfaces.json carries the stack fields (SCHEMA.md reads the same keys).

requirements.title: Proof chain builds
requirements.text: proofs/build_graph.py exits 0 with zero drift; every requirement in this set has >= 1 claim with a how-to-verify line before CDR; build_graph.py --strict passes (no negative margin, no unverified requirement) before the first flight
requirements.how: Run build_graph.py and build_requirements.py; the matrix header shows coverage and fails.

requirements.title: FAA and university compliance
requirements.text: Take-off mass < {P:requirements.mass_max_legal_kg} kg (covered by R-MASS-GATE); FAA registration done and the number displayed on the airframe; each pilot holds a TRUST certificate and AMA membership; aircraft and pilots registered with the UC Drone Program under a PI sponsor; the FAA UAS facility map for RFS checked once and the airspace class recorded
requirements.how: Documents on file and listed in COMPLIANCE.md with dates; photo of the registration label on the airframe.

requirements.title: Site rules and flight card
requirements.text: Flights only at RFS yellow sub-fields 1-4, within 06:00-sunset (flight card 07:00-10:00), <= {P:mission.ceiling_ft_agl} ft AGL, VLOS <= {P:requirements.vlos_max_m} m from the pilot, with a spotter, a request >= 7 business days ahead and a post-flight report within 3 business days; each session starts with the field-map sheet (landing zone, approach sector, alternate spot, clearance of one zone width to the pilot box and other pads, obstacle survey of every object > 3 m (EST) inside the fence, pre-flight walk of zone, sector and alternate; NASA CR-132423 p. 42, 58-59, 166-167; review/NASA-CR-132423-COMPLIANCE.md C-15, G-03); no Remote ID module while every flight is inside the FRIA (a conditional line stays in the BOM)
requirements.how: Flight card signed per session; request and report dates logged; geofence (R-FAILSAFES) matches the sub-field.

requirements.title: Battery handling
requirements.text: Packs are stored and carried at storage charge (3.80-3.85 V/cell) in a LiPo bag; charged attended on a non-flammable surface with sand or an extinguisher at hand, never in a car; inspected for puffing before every charge; bought from US stock and shipped by ground
requirements.how: Procedure sheet in the charging box; per-session checklist signed; cell voltages logged at storage.

requirements.title: Pilot readiness
requirements.text: The designated pilot logs >= {P:requirements.sitl_hours_min} h of ArduPilot SITL on the tailsitter model with the team's parameter file, including QSTABILIZE recovery from a failed transition, plus stick time on the foam-board twin or a small quad, before the first XPS hover
requirements.how: Dated SITL log with hours and the scenarios flown (H2); SITL runs stay UNVERIFIED until the team runs them (SITL is not on the design machine).

requirements.title: Foam-board twin gate
requirements.text: The foam-board twin on the real motors, FC and pack holds position with 95 % of logged position samples within 1 m of the hold point over a 2 min run (NASA CR-132423 p. 49: accuracy stated at 95 percent likelihood; review/NASA-CR-132423-COMPLIANCE.md C-15, G-08) in calm air and in a 5 m/s fan or breeze with logged lean <= {P:requirements.hover_lean_max_deg} deg; flies QLOITER at >= 30 m; completes a transition at >= 1.3 Vs, two laps and a back-transition; hover current within +/-{P:requirements.hover_current_tol} x {P:performance.hover_current_a} A of that value and cruise near {P:performance.cruise_current_a} A; the elevon size that gives clean FBWA authority is recorded. A wind fail triggers the K11 planform test, then the K01 fallback (CONFIGURATION.md)
requirements.how: Each flight logged; the report lists the pass criteria with the measured value beside each.

requirements.title: Test gates in order
requirements.text: Gates passed and logged in order, none skipped: (1) twin (R-TWIN); (2) thrust stand, one station (R-HOVER-TW); (3) XPS aircraft weigh-in (R-MASS-GATE) and tethered hover with current within +/-{P:requirements.hover_current_tol} x {P:performance.hover_current_a} A of that value and the limiter verified (R-ESC-CURRENT); (4) untethered QHOVER/QLOITER; (5) fixed-wing tune as a plain flying wing; (6) first transition at >= {P:requirements.transition_alt_min_m} m AGL with QSTABILIZE recovery rehearsed; (7) back-transition at altitude; (8) landing practice in calm air; (9) full mission (R-MISSION). H3 gives go/no-go on the 5 m/s flight card
requirements.how: Test plan with one page per gate; each gate's log file named in the plan when passed.

requirements.title: RFS wind measured
requirements.text: RFS morning wind is measured with a handheld anemometer on >= 3 mornings at 2 m height against the RCMC1 real-time reading; the ratio RFS/RCMC1 is < {P:requirements.wind_ratio_max} (else the K01 reversal in CONFIGURATION.md applies) and the flight-card limit is rescaled to the measured ratio
requirements.how: Table of date, time, RFS reading, RCMC1 reading, ratio; mean ratio reported.

differences.set: half-fins {P:fins.half_height_m} m each side (fin 0.42 m, D-26; 0.38 m at D-15)
differences.why: 0.40 m was the old fin *chord*; D-26 raised the half-fins to the motor-mount lip for Cn_beta

differences.proposed: envelope 1.15 x 0.445 x 0.39 m; box 0.45 m high
differences.set: envelope transport.envelope_props_off_m ({P:transport.envelope_props_off_m} m, tube ends and splayed pads included); box requirements.box_external_m ({P:requirements.box_external_m} m, D-31; fallback 0.50 m with a 'max drop 0.15 m' label)
differences.why: the ~70 mm cradle stroke in a {P:requirements.box_drop_m} m floor drop costs box height (CL-D7-BOX-H-REQ); CL-A1-BOX-FIT slack 17 mm; D7 measures two cars before the freeze

differences.set: {P:battery.n_packs} flight packs (D-12); packs 3-4 only if the pessimistic reserve stays >= {P:requirements.crash_cost_usd} + 87 USD

differences.why: Tie-break decision section 5.1 conditions the probability claim on it; the margin from cruise down to 1.3 Vs is 0.49-0.58 m/s
Gate 1 of the tie-break is the binding rule

differences.proposed: full throttle ~30 A per motor, ESC 45 A
differences.set: R-ESC-CURRENT around the {P:performance.full_throttle_current_a} A pack-current limiter (Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX): <= {P:propulsion.motor_max_a} A per motor with the limiter, unlimited burst <= {P:propulsion.esc_burst_a} A at 16.8 V (ESC 10 s rating), no full-throttle run > {P:env.full_throttle_max_s} s (D-42), hover {P:performance.hover_current_a} A +/- {P:requirements.hover_current_tol}
differences.why: unlimited full throttle on the 11x5.5MR is 42.4 / 51.6 A at 14.8 / 16.8 V and the motor is rated 25 A / 30 s: the limiter is the design case (CR-E1-07, CR-A1-17, D-34)

differences.set: R-GUST-LEAN: lean <= Q_A_ANGLE_MAX - {P:requirements.gust_angle_margin_deg} deg with thrust headroom >= {P:requirements.gust_thrust_headroom}; landing upright in 8 m/s is not required (flight card {P:requirements.wind_limit_ms} m/s, lay flat above 8 m/s)
differences.why: the 8 m/s lean ({P:performance.lean_8ms_deg} deg) exceeds the tip-over angle (32.4 deg): a landing in such a gust may tip, and the feet (R-LANDING-IMPACT) take it

differences.proposed: tip-over about the narrow axis >= 30 deg
differences.set: R-TIPOVER >= {P:requirements.tipover_min_deg} deg toward the pod side at the worst flying CG with splayed pads and z_cg subtracted (D-30); wingtip into the wind on the flight card
differences.why: C5's planar geometry: unsplayed feet give 28.3-29.2 deg (FAIL); the span-into-wind landing needs 18.3 deg on that axis

differences.set: R-FIELD-SETUP: one 10 mm prop spanner in the box pouch is the single allowed tool (D-40)
differences.why: the M6 prop nut at 1.5 N m is the only field joint needing a tool; a tool-free retention is not worth 4 x 35 s of a 265 s set-up

differences.proposed: hard landing on the feet (no sink speed or tilt stated)
differences.set: R-LANDING-IMPACT: {P:requirements.landing_sink_ms} m/s sink at <= {P:requirements.landing_attitude_err_deg} deg of combined tilt in any direction, n <= {P:requirements.landing_n_design} (D-65); C1's 1.5 m/s L1 / L4 cases stay the structural bounds
differences.why: C5's 6-DOF touchdown: a diagonal touchdown lands on one foot, and at 1.5 m/s a 5 deg tilt already bottoms the 35 mm usable stroke; 1.2 m/s is the most the pilot can command (Q_PILOT_SPD_DN) and the controller lands at 0.3 m/s

differences.set: R-SPIRAL: t2 >= 3.3 s with wing-borne flight only in roll-stabilised modes, no MANUAL / ACRO / STABILIZE above 5 m (D-66 option b)
differences.why: the CG {P:cg.z_target_m} m above the chord plane gives t2 3.51 s against B3's 4 s hand-flown floor and lowering it is not buildable; the autopilot's roll loop holds the bank in every mode F4 ships (D-50), and 3.3 s is the value at the top of cg.z_range_m

differences.set: R-DISCONNECT: <= {P:electrical.wire_temp_rise_max_c} degC steady at the continuous design current (max of hover, cruise, climb), <= {P:electrical.wire_temp_rise_short_max_c} degC for any case < 60 s, pack's own leads <= {P:electrical.pack_lead_rise_max_c} degC steady (CR-F1-01/15, D-56)
differences.why: 10 degC with no duration would also bind the 5 s and 20 s cases and no gauge the mass budget carries meets that; no hobby pack ships with 8 AWG leads

differences.set: R-VIBRATION: fin-station modes >= {P:requirements.vibration_sep_frac} from 1P/2P at the operating points; wing modes by tap test + rpm-tracking notch (D-45); VIBE < {P:requirements.fc_vibe_max_ms2} m/s2
differences.why: no spar from 16 to 25 mm clears the wing-mode windows over the E uncertainty (CL-C2-WING-MODE-SEP 0.077)
A3's roll-up gives 1.19; B3 allows 12.5 % of the pitch differential for trim

differences.set: R-LOADS, R-STRUCT-MARGIN, R-FIN-TUBE-JOINT, R-VIBRATION, R-PACK-RETENTION, R-LANDING-IMPACT
differences.why: the structures roles (C1-C6) need numbers to size against

differences.set: R-HOVER-AUTHORITY (30 % differential cap on every axis, 7 deg cant, D-27), R-CRUISE-AUTHORITY, R-SERVO-TORQUE, R-AIRSPEED, R-COMPASS, R-RC-LINK
differences.why: B3, D6, F3, F5 need pass/fail values

differences.set: R-JOINT-STACK per type: {P:requirements.thread_engagement_min} d metal, {P:requirements.thread_engagement_insert_min} d insert, {P:requirements.thread_engagement_plastic_min} d plastic, nyloc + {P:requirements.nyloc_pitches_min} pitches (D-41)
differences.why: A2 (1.0 d in an insert) and interfaces/SCHEMA.md (1.5 d) disagreed
